An''' Infernal Mage (elite)''' is an [[elite monster|elite version]] of the [[Infernal Mage]]. If on a [[Slayer assignment]], an elite Infernal Mage is guaranteed to spawn; otherwise, elite monsters have a spawn rate of 1 in 1,000. Elite spawn rates can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense sticks]] and tier 1 [[luck]].
